---
title: "5 · Cases"
---

Three released case studies illustrate reporting under different targets and posterior assumptions.
For firm contact gaps, the applications compare [KRW's and postrank's loss scales](lambda-tau.qmd),
[archived cards](krw-card.qmd), [signed and absolute targets](signed-or-absolute.qmd), and a
[common race–gender report](krw-two.qmd). The twelve-school example examines
[grade boundaries](cde-cuts.qmd), [matched disclosure](cde-one-disclosure.qmd), a
[withheld high-probability comparison](cde-pair.qmd) and the [withholding-cost path](cde-tau-path.qmd).
The [Alabama county example](alabama-map.qmd) connects historical outcomes, marginal intervals and archived
commonality-cost bounds. Source notes specify the target orientation, conditioning and terms of use for each case.
